appraisal_events.evidence: Elle a déjeuné chez moi ce matin, dit la marquise du quai Malaquais avec la satisfaction de penser que Mme de Villeparisis n'en pourrait jamais dire autant.
appraisal_events.explanation: Alix pointedly notes that the duchesse de Guermantes lunched at her house, relishing a claim to closeness with the duchess that she believes Mme de Villeparisis cannot match.

appraisal_events.evidence: Je crois qu'il cherchait surtout à se louer et à me faire envie... « Oui, j'ai en effet une vie délicieuse... Rare est le mortel à qui le Père Zeus accorde tant de félicités. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Bloch's inflated, quasi-mythological self-praise and studied nonchalance about his own party are framed by the narrator as vanity performing contentment and courting envy rather than genuine happiness.

appraisal_events.evidence: il se tenait constamment le plus éloigné de moi qu'il pouvait, sans doute dans l'espoir que je n'entendisse pas les flatteries qu'avec un grand raffinement d'expression, il ne cessait à tout propos de prodiguer à Mme de Villeparisis. Elle haussa les épaules en souriant comme s'il avait voulu se moquer.
appraisal_events.explanation: Legrandin lavishes elaborate praise on Mme de Villeparisis while carefully keeping out of the narrator's earshot -- again betraying the gap between his professed disdain for society and his eager flattery of it -- and his effusiveness earns only a dismissive shrug, as if it were mockery.

status_effects.explanation: She asserts a comparative edge over Mme de Villeparisis by claiming a closeness to the duchesse de Guermantes that she believes her rival cannot match.
She is the implicit loser of Alix's comparison, unable to make the same claim about the duchess.
She meets Legrandin's elaborate flattery with an unimpressed shrug and a turn away, declining to be visibly won over -- a separate, later moment from the comparative loss to Alix.
His boastful self-presentation is undercut by the narrator's reading of it as vanity seeking to provoke envy.
His evasive positioning to flatter Mme de Villeparisis unheard exposes, once again, the hypocrisy between his anti-society pose and his actual eagerness to please her.
